Part usage was blocked 3205 — Entered inventory parts don’t correspond to the asset refrigerant 3235 — Failed to process the inventory request 3219 — MOE number is required; part usage cannot be processed 3222 — Inventory part IDs and location IDs or GUIDs should not be null 3309 — There are uncompleted leak records in another WO 3306 — Refrigerant Tracking Connector is turned on. Only the external client's assets can be processed 3307 — Refrigerant Tracking Connector is not supported. Only the client's assets can be processed 3304 — Inventory usage is not allowed on refrigerant tracking for Connected Subscribers and Subcontractors 3237 — Another WO part use request is in processing now. Please try later 3236 — Duplicated parts detected 3327 — The same part is passed for update and removal in the same request 3207 — Parts with specified part IDs were not found 503 — Refrigerant usage cannot be processed. There are no refrigerant settings 503 — Only one asset can be processed in the request 3213 — Asset is not assigned to the work order 3305 — External WO currently doesn’t exist. Refrigerant usage is blocked 3212 — Add part usage: Either remove the Reason Code and the IsRefrigerant flag or specify an asset 3212 — Asset is not using refrigerant. Reason Code and IsRefrigerant values are not allowed 3213 — Either the asset is deactivated or you don’t have access to it 503 — Asset is not connected to any rack 809 — Work order is in the completed status. Only RT Admins can process 3230 — Incorrect refrigerant type entered 4003 — Asset uses refrigerant. RT setting is required 503 — There are no any charge records with the date earlier than the use date 3303 — A closed leak record exists for this work order. Only one leak record can exist per work order. Please enter additional part usage on a new work order 3232 — Leak record part usages cannot be attached to the Retro/Retire plan leak record 503 — Asset doesn’t contain charge prior to the given date 503 — Work order refrigerant leak part usages should belong to the same asset charge 3218 — Use date cannot be after the completed/scheduled date and earlier than the call date 3315 — Used reason code Retrofit cannot be selected for non-retrofit work orders 503 — Description field length cannot be more than 250 symbols 503 — Part number field length cannot be more than 50 symbols 3208 — Request should contain only one work order ID. Work order IDs found: 3206 — Incorrect work order 3201 — Incorrect reason code for the subscriber was entered 3209 — Invalid IsRefrigerant and Reason Code combination 3210 — IsRefrigerant flag cannot be changed 3211 — Reason code change is not allowed 3224 — Add part usages are not allowed after the Retrofit/Retire creation 3223 — Part removal is not allowed on the Retrofit/Retire WO 3319 — Zero charge value. Leak event calculation cannot be executed 3226 — Initial charge or system expansion are not allowed on “Connected to the rack” assets 3201 — System expansion and the leak repair cannot be processed in one WO 3215 — Asset doesn’t contain charge 3217 — Leak record is currently in processing on another work order 3229 — Duplicated request detected. Please wait a minute and try again 3227 — Inventory part cannot be changed 3228 — Inventory location cannot be changed 3231 — Part usage date is not allowed in the Retire/Retrofit date interval 503 — Broken date order in part usages for the system expansion
